svg.title: Decision route from screening to low-coverage calling
svg.desc: Original schematic for grapevine-adna chapters 3 and 4. Screen endogenous content and damage, then deeper shotgun or capture, then plant-applicable contamination checks. hapCon is not a grape method. Imputation only after a pre-registered downsample test on modern grapes. Not a pipeline we ran.
svg.text: From screening to a low-coverage genotype (schematic)
Original figure. Complements docs/WORKFLOW.md; not a run we performed.
Extract + library
blanks sequenced
Shallow screen
damage + endogenous content
Stop or redesign
if damage or yield unusable
Deeper shotgun or capture
then remap and dedup
Contamination checks
see chapter 3
Do not use as grape recipes
hapCon: male modern-human X chromosomes
AuthentiCT: ss libraries only; not UDG or PMD-filtered
schmutzi contDeam: nuclear use at own risk (README Nuclear); hapROH: human-oriented
Calling and imputation (chapter 4)
Prefer likelihoods or haploid draws (repo judgement)
Pseudo-haploid is not a heterozygosity estimate (repo judgement)
GLIMPSE2 only after a pre-registered modern-grape downsample test
UK Biobank accuracy figures are not grape figures
Capture-versus-shotgun threshold for a grape pip: no published cutoff opened for these chapters [待确认].
Same-clone claims still need authentication, blanks, and the tissue-origin caution in WORKFLOW (seed coat vs embryo [待确认]).
Sources: chapters 2–4 claim–source tables (hapCon PMC9344841; AuthentiCT README; GLIMPSE2 PMC10335927).
